subject: general
question: Which Indian Member of Parliament was given the 'India UK Outstanding Achievers Honour' in January 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raghav Chadha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Raghav Chadha, a Member of Parliament from the Rajya Sabha representing the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), was honored with the prestigious **'India UK Outstanding Achievers Honour'** in January 2023.
 
• This award recognizes **Indian students and professionals in the UK** who have excelled in their respective fields and contributed to strengthening India-UK relations.
 
• Raghav Chadha pursued his education at the London School of Economics (LSE), which is one of the leading institutions in the UK.
 
• He has been recognized for his contributions to public service and his role as a prominent young leader in Indian politics.
 
• The event was organized by the **National Indian Students and Alumni Union (NISAU) UK**, in collaboration with the British Council in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India-UK Relations:**

 
 
• India and the UK share a strong bilateral partnership in trade, education, technology, and culture.
 
• Educational exchange programs and scholarships have played a vital role in fostering ties between the two nations.
 
• The UK is one of the leading destinations for Indian students pursuing higher education.
 
 
 
• **National Indian Students and Alumni Union (NISAU) UK:**
 
 
• NISAU UK is a representative body for Indian students and alumni in the UK.
 
• It aims to promote Indian culture, heritage, and achievements on a global scale.
 
 
 
• **London School of Economics (LSE):**
 
 
• LSE is a prestigious academic institution known for its focus on economics, politics, and social sciences.
 
• It has produced numerous notable alumni, including several world leaders and policymakers.
 
 
 
• **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP):**
 
 
• AAP is a political party in India founded in 2012 with a focus on governance transparency and anti-corruption.
 
• The party has gained prominence for its governance model in Delhi and expanding influence across India.
